observed_baseline: Current uncommitted Concept 8B.1 worktree at b57b1ef; product code was read but not changed.

tools.current_surface: Setup left tool drawer; Planning disclosure open; Advanced model details and Scenario workspace disclosures below it.
tools.primary_user_goal: Choose single-cell or network planning and set the active RF profile and planning selection.
inputs: Selected transmitter or network cell set
outputs: Run Sector or Evaluate Network readiness
map_interaction: Cell marker click changes the active cell in Single mode or toggles network membership in Network mode.
Map Focus and selected-cell visualization are controlled separately in the map toolbar.
tools.drawer_density: Moderate in the screenshot: common settings are visible and Scenario workspace remains collapsed; high when Scenario workspace is expanded.
tools.disclosure_depth: Planning > Advanced model details > Scenario workspace; Scenario workspace contains nested Scenario, Version, lineage, Run/Report association and comparison detail.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Tower click opens the current Map Inspector by replacing Setup; Scenario and Version selection remain local to ScenarioPanel.
provenance_shown: Technology/profile context
Model applicability and RF assumptions behind Advanced model details
Scenario panel summary includes dataset and RF mode/profile

tools.current_surface: Inventory left tool drawer with cell list, placement/import actions, and selected-cell RF profile editor.
tools.primary_user_goal: Browse and edit per-cell profile and placement data.
secondary_goals: Import, duplicate, place, move, reset, or delete a cell
inputs: Per-cell frequency, bandwidth, power, antenna, pattern, and receiver profile fields
map_interaction: Map click selects an active cell/cluster member
tools.drawer_density: High when the RF profile editor is open; list and editor compete for one narrow drawer.
tools.disclosure_depth: Cell list > profile fields > advanced receiver/pattern sections.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Selection is task configuration and edits the canonical project draft; it is not read-only inspection.
provenance_shown: Dataset/manual/project-override source metadata where available
Validity and request-ready state

tools.current_surface: Collapsed Scenario workspace disclosure inside Setup; ScenarioPanel expands to a long management surface.
tools.primary_user_goal: Manage saved Scenarios, immutable Versions, branches, drafts, and associated lineage.
secondary_goals: Continue from or branch a Version
map_interaction: No direct map interaction; Version actions affect plan identity and can make result context stale.
tools.drawer_density: Very high when expanded: Scenario switcher, overview, save Version, Version list, selected-Version detail/actions, comparisons, and associations.
tools.disclosure_depth: Setup > Scenario workspace > internal Scenario/version/association sections.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Selected Version is an inspection/navigation context; Continue/Branch are explicit draft mutations.
provenance_shown: Revision IDs/fingerprints and lineage details are partly present in detail views; summary includes source/dataset/profile facts.

tools.current_surface: Propagation left drawer with Planning disclosure open, Advanced analysis and Research/reference disclosures collapsed.
tools.primary_user_goal: Configure and explicitly run a sector propagation/coverage analysis.
map_interaction: Map cell choice sets active transmitter through existing Plan selection; path profile can select a receiver endpoint on the map; result overlays remain in map context.
tools.drawer_density: Low-to-moderate with disclosures collapsed; high after Advanced and Research are both opened.
tools.disclosure_depth: Planning; Advanced analysis (optimization goals plus path profile); Research/reference (Sub-THz plus P.1411 candidate workflows).
tools.selected_object_behavior: Map cell click currently replaces Propagation with Map Inspector. Path profile is a configuration/evidence workflow, not a selected map-ray detail panel.
provenance_shown: Research-only boundaries
Model/profile limits and explicit path-profile disclaimer

tools.primary_user_goal: Queue an asynchronous parameter sweep and compare deterministic per-run outcomes.
inputs: Frequency, TX power, beam width, azimuth, and calibration sweep values
map_interaction: Uses the active transmitter as the base configuration; result comparison appears in drawer rather than as individually inspectable map samples.
tools.drawer_density: Moderate at setup; high after completed results add chart and table.
tools.disclosure_depth: Single panel with form, action row, job progress and result visualization.
tools.selected_object_behavior: No map-selected object; one experiment job/result selection.
provenance_shown: Experiment fingerprint and cache-hit status
Downloaded definition after it exists

tools.current_surface: Statically imported SurfacePanel tool; map toolbar has a separate Signal display toggle.
tools.primary_user_goal: Generate and tune a received-power surface for spatial coverage interpretation.
inputs: Surface options and active RF context
map_interaction: Toggle/render aggregate raster; current raster has no stable clickable point sample in MapCanvas.
tools.drawer_density: Low before computation; moderate with options/output. SurfacePanel is not part of the current Concept 7I lazy feature list.
tools.disclosure_depth: Single tool panel; visualization settings also in map toolbar.
tools.selected_object_behavior: No individual sample selection; surface is aggregate visualization.
provenance_shown: Current/available/loading/error surface status and source context

tools.current_surface: Interference left tool; applicable only for supported Network plans with at least two cells.
tools.primary_user_goal: Analyze co-channel interference and radio quality across the selected network.
inputs: Interference model controls and explicit analyze action
map_interaction: Interference sample click opens Map Inspector; current code records sample metrics and model in its payload.
tools.drawer_density: Moderate; fewer independent workflows than RF Diagnostics.
tools.disclosure_depth: Task controls with model details/provenance available separately.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Sample inspection switches the left drawer to Map Inspector and replaces Interference controls.
provenance_shown: Model family/bandwidth/load details are available in sample/reference output.

tools.current_surface: Canonical action area plus a lazy Research/reference disclosure.
tools.primary_user_goal: Navigate from a canonical RF result to diagnostic path or building-entry evidence, without presenting research as canonical RF.
map_interaction: Path profile routes to Propagation advanced view; map sample features open current Map Inspector.
tools.drawer_density: Canonical view is moderate; Research becomes very high because three separate forms mount vertically.
tools.disclosure_depth: RF Diagnostics > Research/reference > Validation, Materials, Reflection panels (all currently stacked).
tools.selected_object_behavior: Measurement sample can open Map Inspector; path profile is not owned by an inspector.
provenance_shown: Each evidence workflow has its own result/model context; research boundaries are stated.

tools.current_surface: Building Entry tool under Advanced analysis disclosure.
tools.primary_user_goal: Estimate representative facade entry/service for relevant buildings and current cell/network inputs.
secondary_goals: Review explicit denominator and physical-model limits
outputs: Batched summary plus one representative building/detail and diagnostics
map_interaction: Building result detail includes stable building ID/facade point; a separately clicked building opens Map Inspector.
tools.drawer_density: Sparse without result; dense after result because summary, selected building, model facts, and limitations stack.
tools.disclosure_depth: One Advanced analysis wrapper and one tool panel.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Building detail is currently tool output, while a map-selected building is a different Map Inspector path.
provenance_shown: Material evidence, receiver threshold, service denominator, explicit facade-only limitations

tools.current_surface: Lazy optional Core Lab tool for local Open5GS/simulated overlay.
tools.primary_user_goal: Enable and inspect optional 5G core communication paths for applicable 5G plans.
secondary_goals: Run one of the available core scenarios
map_interaction: Communication path click opens Map Inspector; overlay visibility is a map concern.
tools.drawer_density: Low before enabled; moderate-to-high when live status and events exist.
tools.disclosure_depth: Single optional feature surface; internal topology/event groups.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Route selection replaces tool drawer with Map Inspector.
provenance_shown: Simulated overlay versus live mode/source; developer start command is visible by default when disconnected.

tools.current_surface: Results left tool with RF, Optimization, Interference, Compare, and candidate/solution subviews; result context disclosure precedes subview.
tools.primary_user_goal: Interpret outputs from the exact current or retained Run and compare supported result kinds.
outputs: Metrics, gap/feasibility summaries, configuration deltas, comparison and explicit apply/navigation actions
map_interaction: Map result layers show output; clicking an inspectable sample replaces Results drawer with Map Inspector.
tools.drawer_density: High in populated Optimization/Compare/solutions views; result source disclosure is compact when closed.
tools.disclosure_depth: Results > subview > metric/configuration/explanation/detail blocks; candidate selection adds master/detail content in the same drawer.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Pareto selection is kept in Results state and does not recompute or change recommendation; separate from selected map cell and inspector object.
provenance_shown: Freshness, source Run, Scenario/Version context, Details/Provenance; some source facts are expanded rather than primary.

tools.current_surface: Lazy Run History tool with filters/list and selected Run detail in one drawer.
tools.primary_user_goal: Find a retained local Run and inspect its exact source and compact retained result.
outputs: Run status/source/provenance, retained summary/public solutions, Run/Report actions
map_interaction: Historical detail is non-spatial unless map layers are regenerated; no run-selection inspector needed.
tools.drawer_density: Very high: list, three filters, selected detail, full provenance and public solutions all share a 320–360px drawer. Source CSS currently attempts a two-column master/detail inside this narrow surface.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Selected Run detail is internal history selection; it does not become the current plan or result source.
provenance_shown: Run ID, Scenario/Version, timestamps, fingerprints, dataset, engine, RF contract, source links

tools.current_surface: Data left tool with Planning data open and Dataset details, Advanced model details, Research/reference collapsed.
tools.primary_user_goal: Understand data confidence and manage/select the active local dataset pack.
map_interaction: Dataset switch invalidates results; measurement residual output can be shown as a selectable map layer.
tools.drawer_density: High when all disclosures are expanded; default Planning data uses several equally weighted summary facts.
tools.disclosure_depth: Planning data; Dataset details (packs/QA/provenance/CLI); Advanced model details; Research/reference (CSV, residuals, calibration).
tools.selected_object_behavior: Measurement sample click opens Map Inspector; dataset/measurement section does not own one current selected object.
provenance_shown: Dataset version, model/app version, licenses, source list, hashes, data quality and model assumptions
The CSV residual/calibration path is a distinct field-measurement workflow; it can explicitly apply a supported plan correction.

tools.current_surface: Lazy Reports tool with current report export, source context, definitions and stored artifacts.
tools.primary_user_goal: Generate, download, and inspect a report from a named current or historical source.
outputs: Report definition and generated artifact bytes
map_interaction: Report preview/export may carry a map preview but is not a map-selection inspector entity.
tools.drawer_density: Moderate; source panel, export actions, and artifact/definition list.
tools.selected_object_behavior: Selected artifact remains in Reports detail, not a contextual map inspector.
provenance_shown: Current unsaved plan or exact Run/Scenario/Version binding; artifact metadata/storage details in Reports.

inventory_notes: A.T.O.M already has MapInspector renderers for tower, building, coverage gap, communication path, interference sample, measurement sample, and site recommendation.
That surface is not a right inspector: App sets drawerMode=inspector and ToolDrawer replaces the current tool. Tower marker click also changes active tower/network membership and map Focus.
A signal surface is currently an aggregate raster; no stable clickable signal-surface sample was found.
Screenshot coverage comes from Concept 8B.1 after-state files; source inspection supplements panels that were not captured.
